script_text: Stop, Aries, because your 5th House will erupt, and ignoring this cosmic collision could cost you. Mars, your fire-sign ruler, is conjunct Jupiter in your 5th House of Leo, amplifying creativity. Mars sextiles Venus in your 7th House of Libra; Saturn and Neptune are conjunct in your 12th House of Pisces, exposing buried financial costs. If single, you attract someone confident, magnetic, and creative through a social or artistic connection; if taken, watch for pride disguised as honesty when Mars and Venus activate your 7th House. Career and money favor a bold pitch or creative lead in the 10th House, but check 8th-House expenses and contracts before committing. Unexpected gift: a warm introduction may open well-paid opportunities if you resist overpromising under this Mars-Jupiter heat. Follow for tomorrow's reading, and subscribe so you can catch the next Aries shift.
